title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
html:
Two-factor authentication is a security feature that increases the protection of accounts: signing in requires not only a password but also a unique code generated by an authenticator application.

Steps to enable it:

  1. Click your name in the top right corner, then select the Security settings menu.

  2. The system generates a QR code — scan it with an authenticator application (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator).

  3. To confirm activation, enter the 6-digit code shown by the application.

After activation, the code generated by the authenticator application must be entered at every sign-in.

⚠ Caution

If you lose access to the authenticator application, notify the system administrator so that it can be reset.
